posts.zh:
dsh-desktop-windowos 已收录到 DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store。Windows 托盘桌面壳：自动从 GitHub Releases 安装并升级 exe、创建应用与网页端两个桌面快捷方式，并提供 desktop_launch 工具在对话中一键启动。

查看来源与安装：https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-6dd1a5956d7fa01a429d.html
posts.en:
dsh-desktop-windowos is now listed on the DeepSeek Harness Plugin Store. Windows tray desktop shell: auto-installs and auto-updates the exe from GitHub Releases, creates desktop shortcuts for both the app and the web UI, and exposes a desktop_launch tool to start it from the conversation.

Source and install details: https://deeplugin.store/plugins/deeplugin-6dd1a5956d7fa01a429d.html
